scripts.build: bun run clean && tsc -b packages/core packages/plugin packages/react packages/web packages/next packages/tanstack-start packages/provider-better-auth packages/provider-authjs packages/migrate
scripts.test:fixture: bun install --cwd fixtures/payload-auth-app && vitest run -c vitest.migration.config.ts
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run ci:lint && bun run build && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run coverage && bun run size && bun run api:check && bun run schema:check && bun run consumer:check
scripts.dev:example: bun run build && cd examples/basic && bun run dev
scripts.e2e: bun run build && playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts
scripts.e2e:postgres: bun run build && playwright test -c e2e/playwright.postgres.config.ts
scripts.e2e:tanstack: bun run build && playwright test -c e2e/playwright.tanstack.config.ts
scripts.e2e:seed-gate: bun run build && playwright test -c e2e/playwright.seed-gate.config.ts
scripts.e2e:mfa: bun run build && playwright test -c e2e/playwright.mfa.config.ts
scripts.release:check: bun run build && bun scripts/release-check.mjs && bun run release:smoke
scripts.docs:check: bun run build && bun scripts/check-docs.mjs && typedoc --treatWarningsAsErrors
